chapter_title: The World of Limitless Possibilities & Nine Gold Medals
summary: Unit 5 explores inclusivity and sportsmanship through an interview with pioneering Paralympic medalist Dr. Deepa Malik and David Roth's poem 'Nine Gold Medals'. Deepa Malik's life demonstrates how mental fortitude transforms physical adversity into world-record athletic achievements. Roth's poem celebrates empathy at the Special Olympics, where athletes choose solidarity over individual victory.

hotspots.title: Dr. Deepa Malik
hotspots.description: First Indian woman Paralympic Silver Medalist (Rio 2016 Shot Put F53).

hotspots.title: Nine Gold Medals
hotspots.description: Special Olympics 100m dash where 8 runners helped a fallen peer & walked together.

key_takeaways: True ability resides in mental fortitude rather than physical perfection.
Empathy and solidarity embody the highest ideals of sportsmanship.
Universal design and accessible infrastructure are fundamental civic rights.
